source: Apache Commons Lang GitHub Pull Request and source history
technology: Apache Commons Lang / Java / reflection and accessible method resolution
error_description: MethodUtils.invokeMethod can throw IllegalAccessException for an instance of a non-public class even when a compatible public method declaration exists on an interface implemented by that class.
i_base: MethodUtils.getMatchingAccessibleMethod has an exact-signature fast path and a fallback method-search path.
The fast path can return a Method declared by the receiver's concrete runtime class.
Java reflection access checks can prevent invoking a public method declared on a non-public class from the caller's context.
A compatible public instance declaration may exist on an interface implemented by that class.
The fix resolves the exact instance-method result through the accessible-method lookup and avoids treating static or private interface methods as inherited instance methods.

ccdg.details: The invocation utility selects a method before reflective invocation.
The fast path bypassed the public declaration lookup.
The public contract method may be accessible even when the implementation class is not.
An inaccessible implementation declaration triggers IllegalAccessException.

ground_truth.entity: exact-signature Method declared on a non-public runtime class
ground_truth.operation: resolve an accessible instance method before invocation

software_twin_snapshot.observed_failure_signal: Invoking a public interface method through a non-public implementation raised IllegalAccessException on the pinned pre-fix revision.
